issues.note: A bare length of time takes for, not during; contradicts the learner error.
During cannot take a clause; *during we were eating* is ungrammatical.
Same misfit: duration phrase needs for, so the example misfits the sense.
The clause claim contradicts the learner-error note saying during takes a noun.

findings.F1: Sense 1 example 'I felt sick during three hours.' uses during with a bare duration (needs for), contradicting the entry's own learner error.
findings.F2: Usage note falsely says during can take a clause with its own subject (*during we were eating*), contradicting the learner-error note.
